The Rowan, deck, pergola and compact sauna: drawings, revision D

Prepared for Chris Hollis, Two Ways, Praa Sands. Six A3 sheets at 1:50. Deck option. Updated 25 Nov 2026: sheet 106 adds the chassis and wheel positions, and sheet 107 shows the two roof options with their heights. Sheets 101 to 104 were drawn before Chris measured the louvres at 90, so they still show a 200 allowance and the raised roof at about 3590. Where they differ, sheets 106 and 107 take priority. Pergola: Shadow Metal Pergola, Graphite Grey, 4.0 x 3.0 m, code W24180.
